subject: Re: Scheduling demo — procurement gating (NDA + questionnaire)
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@gammahealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + demo request — procurement checkbox

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intros on the call earlier. Gamma Health would love to see a product demo next week as discussed, but our procurement/legal team has a couple of gating items before we can go live with scheduling the full demo:

- NDA needs to be executed (we can sign).
- Vendor security questionnaire needs to be completed or at least kickoff review (SaaS onboarding team).

I've attached our vendor onboarding packet for reference — legal usually requires the NDA + questionnaire to be in motion before they approve a live demo with engineers. Proposed demo windows: Tue 2026-06-08 10–11 PT or Wed 2026-06-09 13–14 PT.

Are you able to send an NDA/DocuSign and a checklist so our procurement can prioritize? If those items take a few days, we can move the demo later — just want to avoid no-shows when procurement is still finalizing.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Partnerships
Gamma Health

Attachments: Gamma_Vendor_Onboarding_Reqs.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@gammahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-01T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request — procurement checkbox

Hi Alicia — thanks for the context and for sending the onboarding packet. Looping in Marissa (solutions) and Rishi (sales engineering) so we can coordinate.

We can absolutely get an NDA over via DocuSign today and share a short vendor checklist to speed procurement along. Two quick notes:

1) If procurement needs to complete the questionnaire before a technical demo, we recommend scheduling a short 30-min discovery call this week (non-technical) to cover scope while legal/ procurement do their work. That keeps momentum.

2) If procurement needs up to a week to finish the questionnaire, we should move the demo to the following week to ensure the engineers can present without gating items.

I’ll send the DocuSign NDA now and attach our onboarding checklist. Marissa — any availability to do a 30-min intro this Thu (6/3) afternoon PT? Rishi — can you prepare a light agenda (30 min) we can use for the discovery?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@gammahealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-02T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request — procurement checkbox

Thanks Vanessa — I can do Thu 6/3 at 3:00 PM PT for a 30-min intro. Proposed agenda:

- 5m intros & objectives
- 10m high-level product fit (where Redwood typically helps healthcare customers)
- 10m procurement/questions and next steps
- 5m checklist/timelines for the technical demo

If procurement is still completing the questionnaire after that call, we’ll plan the full technical demo for the week of 6/8 or 6/15 depending on their timeline.

Alicia — is Thu 3:00 PM PT workable for you and Ben?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@gammahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Whitaker <ben.whitaker@gammahealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request — procurement checkbox

Hi Marissa — Thu 6/3 at 3:00 PM PT works for us. Our legal estimates: NDA signed via DocuSign within 24–48 hours; the vendor questionnaire will take ~3–5 business days to collect answers from our security team. Given that, we’d prefer to do the short intro on Thu and then book the full technical demo for the week of 6/15 to give procurement time.

Please go ahead with the DocuSign link — I’ll route to legal today. Thanks!

— Alicia

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@gammahealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-04T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request — procurement checkbox

Hi all — quick update: DocuSign was completed this morning (thanks Alicia/legal). Attached is the signed NDA for your records.

Per the procurement timeline Alicia shared, let’s tentatively schedule the technical demo for Tue 2026-06-16 10:00–11:00 PT. If procurement finishes earlier we can move it earlier; if not, this date gives the security team time to complete the questionnaire.

I’ve also attached our vendor onboarding checklist (fillable) — feel free to populate and send back; we can help where needed.

Calendar invite will follow once you confirm the date.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Gamma_Health_NDA-signed.pdf (application/pdf), Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@gammahealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-04T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request — procurement checkbox

Thanks Rishi — NDA received and uploaded to our vendor portal. Tue 6/16 10:00–11:00 PT works for our calendar; please send the invite and any pre-demo notes you want us to review. We will start the questionnaire today and aim to have the first pass back by EOD Fri 6/5.

Looking forward to the intro on Thu and the demo on 6/16.
\Best,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Partnerships, Gamma Health
